docx-block-000103.text:
【优先测试主路线（标准金属对角化）】：
  UKS .TRUE.
  &DIAGONALIZATION (STANDARD)
  &SMEAR / METHOD FERMI_DIRAC / ELECTRONIC_TEMP 300
  &MIXING / METHOD BROYDEN_MIXING / ALPHA 0.2
  ADDED_MOS 80
  EPS_SCF 1.0E-6 (优化/静态) | 1.0E-8 (力计算)

docx-block-000104.text: 纠偏修正：不将 OT 与 Broyden mixing 混写。优先采用传统对角化 + Fermi–Dirac 展宽 + Broyden 密度混合 + ADDED_MOS 路线；若需测试直接有限温度 OT，须严格按对应 CP2K 版本文档单独配置并在 WP1 试算中验证。

explanation: Real DOCX places ADDED_MOS 80 inside a multi-line table cell whose label is 'SCF 收敛策略（明确区分路线）'. The parser splits at the first '：' and assigns the entire remainder as the value of field 'scf', so ADDED_MOS is retained only inside method.scf / field_provenance.method.scf. The upstream unit test uses a standalone paragraph 'ADDED_MOS 80', which matches the implicit label-value regex and produces method.added_mos; that synthetic case does not occur in the real DOCX.
